title: Self-Directed Apple Tasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.06677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the classical apple-tasting setting, a partial feedback model in which the learner observes the true label only when it predicts $1$. A combinatorial characterization for the rates of this problem in the online adversarial setting has been studied by Raman et al. (2024). We study the self-directed setting, in which the learner can adaptively choose the order of the points it predicts on. In the realizable setting, we establish a tetrachotomy on the expected minimax number of mistakes made by any learner. Depending on the VC dimension, the $\emptyset$-centered star number, and the self-directed dimension, we show that the rates could possibly be $\Theta(1)$, $O(\log n) \cap \omega(1)$, $\tilde \Theta(\sqrt{n})$, or $\Theta(n)$. In the agnostic setting, the minimax regret is $\tilde \Theta(\sqrt{n})$ or $\Theta(n)$, depending on the VC dimension.

translated_abstract: 我们研究经典的苹果品尝设置，这是一种部分反馈模型，其中学习者只有在其预测为 $1$ 时才能观察到真实标签。Raman 等人（2024）已经研究了该问题在在线对抗设置下的错误率组合刻画。我们研究自导向设置，即学习者可以自适应地选择其进行预测的点的顺序。在可实现设置中，我们针对任何学习者的期望最小最大错误次数建立了四分法刻画：根据 VC 维、$\emptyset$-中心星数和自导向维数，错误率可能为 $\Theta(1)$、$O(\log n) \cap \omega(1)$、$\tilde \Theta(\sqrt{n})$ 或 $\Theta(n)$。在不可知设置中，最小最大遗憾为 $\tilde \Theta(\sqrt{n})$ 或 $\Theta(n)$，具体取决于 VC 维。
tldr: 本文在自导向苹果品尝问题中，通过 VC 维、$\emptyset$-中心星数和自导向维数等组合参数，建立了可实现设置下最小最大错误率的四分法刻画，以及不可知设置下遗憾率的二分法刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a tetrachotomy of minimax mistake rates for the self-directed apple-tasting problem in the realizable setting, characterized by the VC dimension, the $\emptyset$-centered star number, and the self-directed dimension, along with a dichotomy of regret rates in the agnostic setting.
